results.title: Second Amendment Lesson: Britain Disarmed Its Citizens, Now Requires a Police License to Sell Kitchen Knives
results.description: Americans can still buy a kitchen knife without asking the police, but Britain's Home Office announced on Wednesday that every business and private individual who sells a knife of any kind, butter knives and steak knives included, will need a government license to do it. The British government calls the plan a world first.
